Hi Sofie —

We can run the exercise. Attached is an initial outline that maps stages to owners and a first-cut timeline (Attachment: initial-cutover-outline.pdf). High-level plan:

1) Pre-check window (48-24h): verify backups, certs, DNS TTLs, KMS policy read-only check.
2) Staged switchover (T0): drain EU read-only paths, flip route tables for control-plane to APAC standby, verify KV cache consistency.
3) Validation (T0+30m): run synthetic traffic and residency assertions.
4) Rollback (T0+60m): revert routing, re-sync caches, re-enable EU primary.

Requests from our side:
- Confirm the exact maintenance window in APAC and a point-of-contact in your ops team.
- Confirm whether the EU KMS key holder will temporarily authorize our service account to unwrap tokens for the exercise (we will not rotate keys).

I'm looping in Lauren for control-plane concerns, Karthik for peering and DNS, and Vivek for ops runbook and rollback thresholds. We should meet tomorrow 10:00 UTC for a 30-minute dry run planning call unless you prefer another time.
